data.verbatim: this animation doesnt look like hte rest of the animations so it feels disconnected
data.interpretation: Owner requests visual continuity with the accepted animations. R40 shares colors but introduces a different room, character design and performance style.
data.scope: R40 short workshop test visual language; no acceptance of output or change to narration/avatar requirements.

context.narrative_job: Reveal owner dependence while remaining inside the episode visual world.
context.viewer_before: The business is already established through a recognizable illustrated workshop and restrained model actors; R40 looks like a different animation.
context.viewer_after: The same recognizable business remains while one owner-dependent operating relationship becomes visible.

data.choice: Retire the R40 cartoon-workshop treatment from the forward direction. Rebase the next short revision on the accepted workshop enclosure, table illustration and simple model-actor/route vocabulary, then solve the operating dependency within that world.
data.reason: A short mechanism experiment changed style, identity and framing as well as action. Matching palette did not preserve continuity, and tiny hardware gestures still failed to establish the dependency.

alternatives.reason_not_selected: Colors already match; the mismatch is in representation, characters, framing and motion.
It would restore familiarity while retaining the owner-returned clutter and explanatory headings.

alternatives.choice: Use presenter-led coverage with a short consequence insert
alternatives.reason_not_selected: Retained as fallback if a focused mechanism cannot add value within the accepted world.

reuse.applies_when: A local scene revision or mechanism test belongs to an already established episode visual world.
reuse.avoid_when: A different style or world is deliberately authorized and the transition has a narrative purpose.

animation.form: Same illustrated business as a persistent model; specific replacement causal action still to be resolved
animation.mark_style: Use the accepted asset geometry, authored thin/broken strokes, compact figures, restrained fills and one purposeful active change
animation.entry: Recognize the established workshop/business immediately; no additional film zoom required
animation.change: Expose a specific owner-dependent operating connection; keep unaffected business assets present
animation.hold: Show the resulting unresolved operation without implying the actual seller is known to fail
animation.exit: Not frame-locked until the new action is designed against the original narration

nuance.performance: Do not import R40 full-body cartoon cast or walking rig. Future presenter hand-movement requirement remains separately open.
nuance.source_basis: Current owner feedback, root encoded-frame comparison and accepted source assets.
nuance.false_inference: A style match is not a causal-comprehension pass or an owner acceptance of an unseen replacement.

evidence.locator: Concrete continuity correction and remaining causal question
